sources.title: Alibaba DAMO Academy releases ClinFusion open medical AI
sources.snippet: According to GitHub reporting, Alibaba DAMO Academy has released ClinFusion, a vision-centric multimodal large language model system designed for holistic medical understanding. The open-source release encompasses model weights and code to support both 2D and native 3D medical image analysis.
